hook: Leaky water tankers in Hyderabad face *₹5,000* fines from Nov 1
tldr: HMWSSB will fine tankers ₹5,000 for spilling drinking water, and launch treated-water tankers in November.

beats.what: HMWSSB MD K Ashok Reddy ordered ₹5,000 fines on tankers that spill drinking water, from November 1.
beats.why: Overfilled tankers, leaks and loose lids waste water on roads and make them slippery for riders.
beats.care: Spot a tanker spilling water in your lane? From Nov 1 it can be fined. A second offence cancels its registration.

cards.body: Tankers with leaks or missing lids can't fill up until fixed. Separately, 'Green Water' tankers will sell treated sewage water for construction, parks and road cleaning, booked via an app.
Water stress isn't just a city story: Siasat reports Basar IIIT (about 9,000 students) is moving classes online from Oct 26 as the Godavari dries up.

cards.q: Seen a water tanker spilling water on your road?
What happens to a tanker caught wasting water a second time?
cards.why: First offence: ₹5,000. Second: the tanker's registration is cancelled.

viz.l: fine per tanker for wasting drinking water

steps.e: MD K Ashok Reddy issues the orders
Fines start; Green Water set-up due

viz.l: Basar IIIT students going online over water shortage

learn.t: Treated sewage water from STPs (sewage treatment plants) is safe for building and gardening, not drinking. Using it saves potable water.

watch: Whether HMWSSB shares a complaint number for spills, and the Green Water launch date and price.
